topic: Roger's words invited the Great Pirate Era, but Whitebeard's chapter 576 declaration that the One Piece is real is what proved it
title: Whitebeard's Last Words Matter More Than Roger's
description: Roger started the Great Pirate Era with an invitation. Whitebeard's dying words at Marineford turned it into a fact. Here's my case for why chapter 576 matters more than chapter 1. Which one actually started the era?
hook_text: ROGER LIT IT. WHITEBEARD PROVED IT
comment: Who really started the Great Pirate Era: Roger with his invitation, or Whitebeard with his proof? Pick one.

lines.text: Roger started the Great Pirate Era. But Whitebeard made it real.

lines.text: Here's my read, and yes, it's a hot take.
Chapter 1. Roger stands on the scaffold and tells the world his treasure is out there for anyone to find.

lines.text: Whitebeard, the strongest man alive, is dying in front of the entire world.
And he says one thing: the One Piece is real.
